primary_metric: number of new build scenarios containing both a native-success and native-failure replay-eligible episode
falsification: Zero new mixed-outcome scenarios rejects sufficiency of this extension for independent same-task contrast evidence; success alone is not a contract effect or admission
selection_note: Take the next four unallocated scenario groups in the original hash order after excluding every previous build/dev/audit/evaluation group and the oracle scenario; retain first variant and two replicates. Do not move reserved groups, substitute failures or select by instructions/results.
interpretation: Independent build-source acquisition only, not held-out evaluation, learned-memory gain or a causal cross-cycle comparison. All cycle11 model, prompt, tool, environment, token, horizon and context settings are unchanged.
